description: An overview of Celery workers, queues and task runs. Shows task throughput, success rate, runtime and queue wait time, with a per-task table that links to the Celery / Tasks / By Task dashboard. The dashboards were generated using [celery-exporter](https://github.com/danihodovic/celery-exporter). Open issues and create feature requests in the repository.

panels.description: Number of Celery workers currently reporting as up. A sudden drop means workers crashed or were scaled down.
panels.title: Workers

panels.description: Number of tasks currently executing across all workers.
panels.title: Active Tasks

panels.description: Number of distinct queues with reported queue length.
panels.title: Queues

panels.description: Total number of tasks waiting in all queues. A growing value means workers cannot keep up with the arrival rate.
panels.title: Queued Tasks

panels.description: Average rate of tasks received by workers over the last hour.
panels.title: Task Rate [1h]

panels.description: Share of finished tasks that succeeded over the last hour.
panels.title: Task Success Rate [1h]

panels.description: Current queue depth across queues (top 10 by length). Shows which queues have the most pending tasks.
panels.title: Queue Length by Queue

panels.description: Top 10 queues by task throughput over the last hour.
panels.title: Task Rate by Queue [1h]

panels.description: Top 10 tasks by throughput over the last hour. High-volume tasks are candidates for optimization and dedicated worker queues.
panels.title: Task Rate by Name [1h]

panels.description: Distribution of task outcomes over the last hour. A healthy system is predominantly Succeeded. Significant Retried or Rejected slices indicate reliability issues.
panels.title: Task Outcomes [1h]

panels.description: Rate of task lifecycle events over time.
panels.title: Task States

panels.description: Share of finished tasks that succeeded.
panels.title: Task Success Rate

panels.description: Task runtime percentiles across all tasks.
panels.title: Task Runtime

panels.description: Per-task statistics over the last 24 hours for the 40 busiest tasks. Click a task to open it in the Celery / Tasks / By Task dashboard.
panels.title: Tasks Overview [24h]

panels.description: Failed task runs over the last 24 hours, grouped by task and exception.
panels.title: Task Exceptions [24h]

panels.description: Number of tasks waiting in each queue.
panels.title: Queue Length

panels.description: Rate of tasks received by workers per queue.
panels.title: Task Rate by Queue

panels.description: Time tasks spend in the queue between being sent and starting on a worker. Requires task_send_sent_event to be enabled on the client. Rising values mean workers are saturated.
panels.title: Queue Wait Time
